body:
## Parent

https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/43

## What to build

Produce one reproducible acceptance account for the completed #43 behavior across the actual built laptop UI/backend and production watch offline runtime, then build and rehearse the complete versioned watch bundle with the migrated configuration and independent recovery. Update the active acceptance expectations so the superseded wheel-owned editor is no longer treated as a requirement or current proof.

The preceding slices own their focused behavior tests and evidence. This ticket composes those scenarios, fills demonstrated integration gaps and updates acceptance provenance; it does not defer all testing until integration or reopen the agreed domain/interaction/test-boundary decisions.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Run the same reusable action/raw-frame scenarios against both real implementations and retain matching independently expected outcomes: all four exact defaults; schema-1 mixed custom/unconfigured migration; remembered omitted dip; whole-editor local Save/Cancel; active keypad Save; up hierarchy and both horizontal wraps; removed obsolete targets; validation, failed save/retry, recovery and restart.
- [ ] Demonstrate full user journeys through actual laptop pointer/Canvas/backend and watch main/touch/Graphics/native Storage routes. Retain exact inputs, expected/observed screens and saved state, renderings, outgoing packets/chunks, Storage effects, source versions/hashes and explicit simulator/replay/controlled-BLE/simulated-hardware provenance. No private helper tests or mocked application modules count as integration evidence.
- [ ] Confirm zero editor setting packets/read prerequisites across opening, entry, inclusion, navigation, Save/invalid Save/failure/retry/Cancel; changing wheel readings/session/reconnection cannot alter local input. Verify saved omitted Road/Drag dip, included zero/nonzero, stale/duplicate completions, stale import/reload, and no command/draft/confirmation replay after restart.
- [ ] Regression-test the separate immediate riding-menu application using saved included values: each default emits the exact sensitivity/assist packets and no dip; included zero/nonzero uses the existing dip command. Preserve during-riding eligibility, no extra dialog/Apply step, immutable saved requests, one active operation/no tap queue, five-second submission bound, existing native chunk deadlines, ten-second post-submission confirmation bound and two fresh matching current-session settings frames for every included field.
- [ ] Preserve explicit requested/submitted/confirmed distinctions, mismatch/failure/partial/unknown/timeout/disconnect outcomes, session/revision invalidation, stopped-unsent-write behavior and no automatic rollback/retry/reconnect replay. A configuration Save during a pending application stops unsent continuation under existing revision rules; it never labels a local preset wheel-confirmed.
- [ ] Verify alert editing/persistence, dashboard freshness, recording/read-only replay, browser ownership/lifecycle, eligible horn request behavior in controlled tests, wake-only sleeping button cycles and prolonged-hold independent recovery. Preserve removed synchronization/transfer scope.
- [ ] Build and verify the complete content-versioned watch bundle and rehearse staged installation/activation in the established offline runtime. Exercise fresh, migrated and custom saved configuration across compatible startup, versioned module imports, failed/absent-main recovery and held-button recovery. Retain manifest/hashes and synthetic activation evidence without claiming physical flash atomicity or memory fit.
- [ ] Update active editor/laptop/watch acceptance documentation and scenario/check entry points to #43. Update conflicting editor expectations in acceptance milestones #31 and #38 to local editing, defaults, Save/Cancel and gestures while preserving their outstanding owner/hardware requirements. Do not close those milestones or alter parent #43/#17; #41/#42 and ADR 0001 remain historical superseded editor references, not prerequisite work.
- [ ] Retain older evidence with original provenance and label it as the previous interaction. Produce a clear expected/observed/passed/failed/pending matrix with artifact references; no old wheel-editor pass may establish acceptance of this revision. Publish sanitized summaries only; private raw recordings/backups/community archives stay off the tracker.
- [ ] Complete relevant focused checks, Python/frontend typechecking and the full repository checks with browser flows enabled. Record exact reproduction commands and outcomes in the acceptance artifacts. Unknown or failed checks remain visible and incomplete.
- [ ] Keep required live wheel evidence #9, laptop owner/live acceptance #31, deployment/recovery gate #37 and physical display/input/vibration, memory fit, flash/BLE and actual-watch acceptance #38 separate and pending where not actually performed. This ticket needs no live wheel experiment, audible horn, deployment or firmware operation and cannot close those gates using offline results.

## Tests and evidence

- Reuse the approved public application action/raw-notification/observable-view/command-output boundaries and existing actual UI/runtime/storage harnesses. Compare the same literal expectations against each system, not one implementation's output treated as the other's expected value.
- Include first-save and interrupted migration/save, legacy-only valid recovery copy, corrupt/unknown/oversized configuration, custom edits across restart/update, backup export/reviewed import/restore and stale-preview guards. Use controlled file/flash/BLE/clock faults around real application/store/transport code.
- Run the existing complete check entry point with browser checks enabled plus relevant typechecking; keep bundle rehearsal and lifecycle regressions reproducible. Fix integration defects uncovered by these checks within #43's settled behavior, retaining evidence of the corrected result.

## Blocked by

- https://github.com/EvgenyHitexis/EucWatch/issues/49 — completes the matching gesture/runtime journey and transitively requires both platforms' defaults, migration and local editor slices. No extra redundant blocking edges are needed.
title: Refresh preset acceptance evidence and rehearse the versioned watch bundle
